What we clean

Every surface takes a different pressure, a different nozzle, and sometimes a different chemical entirely. We match the method to the material, not the other way around.

Driveways

Oil stains, efflorescence, and years of tire grime, lifted with surface cleaners built for concrete — without pitting or etching it.

Walkways

Algae, moss, and grime cleared from paths and steps so the concrete looks even and the surface stays safe to walk on.

Trash cans

Bins scrubbed inside and out and sanitized on the spot, so trash day stops smelling like trash day.

Garages

Oil drips, dust, and built-up grime pressure washed off the floor and walls, so the space actually looks like part of the house again.

How a job runs

Three steps, start to finish. Most residential jobs are done the same day.

01

Walkthrough & quote

We look at every surface in person and give a flat price before we touch anything. No surprises after we start.

02

The wash

Pressure and chemical are calibrated per surface — hot water and heavy pressure for concrete, gentler settings for garages and trash cans.

03

Final walk

We inspect every section with you before we call it done and collect payment. If you see a spot we missed, we go back.
